paper.title_en: The structural challenges of the path-integral formulation of quantum gravity: A pedagogical guide to the measure problem
paper.abstract_en: General relativity and quantum field theory form the two main pillars of modern physics, yet a fully satisfactory quantum description of the gravitational field remains elusive. The path-integral formulation offers a common language for quantum field theory and semiclassical gravity, and it is often taken as the starting point for candidate theories of quantum gravity. For students who know standard path integrals in flat spacetime, it is natural to ask why simply “doing the same for the metric” is so hard. This article provides a pedagogical treatment of the structural obstacles that arise when extending the path-integral formalism from fixed backgrounds to dynamical spacetime geometry. We focus on the functional measure over metrics, gauge fixing and ghosts, and the Euclidean conformal factor problem, and we contrast these with the better behaved case of matter fields on a fixed background. The aim is to clarify the specific mathematical obstruction caused by the unboundedness of the Euclidean gravitational action and the indefiniteness of the corresponding path-integral measure. We also summarize related open problems, including non-perturbative dynamics and the problem of time, and suggest how the material can be used in teaching.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以教学性综述方式系统梳理量子引力路径积分表述中的结构性障碍（泛函测度、规范固定与鬼场、欧氏共形因子问题），主题契合引力度规理论基础，对读者理解该方向的核心困难有参考价值；但属综述/教学性质，原创性有限，且发表时间极新、引用为零（按规则不计为负面）。
decision.title_zh: 量子引力路径积分表述的结构性挑战：测度问题的教学指南
decision.abstract_zh: 广义相对论与量子场论构成现代物理学的两大支柱，然而对引力场的一个完全令人满意的量子描述仍然缺失。路径积分表述为量子场论与半经典引力提供了一种共同语言，并常被作为量子引力候选理论的出发点。对于熟悉平直时空中标准路径积分的学生而言，自然会问：为什么简单地对度规“做同样的事”会如此困难。本文对把路径积分形式从固定背景推广到动力学时空几何时出现的结构性障碍作教学性处理。我们聚焦于度规上的泛函测度、规范固定与鬼场，以及欧氏共形因子问题，并将它们与固定背景上物质场这一表现更好的情形相对照。其目的在于厘清由欧氏引力作用量的无下界性以及相应路径积分测度的不定性所引起的具体数学障碍。我们还概述了相关的开放问题，包括非微扰动力学与时间问题，并就这些材料如何用于教学提出建议。
